oracleRisk.summary: pmUSD uses an external gold-linked price for RWf(x) treasury accounting, but RAAC explicitly disables liquidation and self-liquidation, so there is no external liquidation-oracle branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: RAAC documents pmUSD as a manager-only RWf(x) fToken where xPM absorbs collateral-price volatility, the treasury reads an Instruxi/Chainlink-linked RWA price, and all liquidation and self-liquidation mechanisms are disabled. Under-collateralization instead blocks operations and permits pro-rata fToken redemption, so collateral liquidation branches are not applicable.
